transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've had pain in my left flank for the last four or five days, and it goes across my back too. I've also been feeling nauseous and have been vomiting.
Could you describe how the flank pain has been affecting you day to day, and let me know if you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
The pain has been there for four or five days now, and it bothers me a good deal. As for allergies, I don't know of any bad reactions to medicines.
Could you tell me what medicines you take regularly, including any new or recently changed ones?
I can't think of any medicines I take regularly. I'm not aware of any new or recently changed ones either.
Can you tell me about your past health, such as any long-lasting conditions, past illnesses, operations, or times you’ve stayed in hospital?

The main thing is that another doctor told me I have a stone of about 1.3 cm in my left ureter, the tube from the kidney. Apart from that, I can't recall any other long-lasting conditions, operations, or hospital stays.

Besides the nausea and vomiting you mentioned, have you noticed any changes since this started in your appetite, sleep, weight, or energy, or any changes in your bladder or bowel habits or breathing? It’s fine if none of these have changed.

I haven't noticed any changes in my appetite, sleep, weight, energy, bowel habits, or breathing. As for my bladder, there's no blood in my urine and no pain or burning when I pass urine—just the nausea and vomiting I mentioned.
Can you tell me more about the pain in your left side—how it comes and goes, and whether anything seems to make it better or worse?

The pain has just been there steadily for the last four or five days—I haven't noticed it coming and going in any particular pattern. I also can't say that anything in particular makes it better or worse.
What’s worrying you most about what’s been going on, and what are you hoping to get from this visit?
What worries me most is this stone of about 1.3 cm in my left ureter that another doctor told me about. I'm hoping something can be done about it.
Is there anything else you’ve noticed or would like to add about how you’ve been feeling?
No, I think that's everything. It's mainly the left flank pain, the nausea and vomiting, and wanting something done about that stone.
Can you describe what the pain in your left side feels like, in your own words?
It's a pain in my left flank that also spreads across my back and involves my abdomen. I can't really describe it any better than that—it's just been a steady pain.
How bad is the pain in your left side — for example, if 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst you can imagine, what number would you give it, and how much is it affecting what you can do day to day?
I can't really put a number on it from 0 to 10; I just know the pain has been there steadily for four or five days. I'm not able to say specifically how much it affects what I do day to day.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
